root_cause_criterion.description: When dims aliases the stack buffer (do_clean == 0), matvar->rank must not exceed 13 (the maximum number of dimensions that fit in uncomp_buf[2..15]).
root_cause_criterion.evidence: vulnerable original: rank=694 > 13 with dims_copy exercised (violated); fixed original: rank=694 > 13, fix guard breaks before loop (guarded); perturbation rank_boundary_2: rank=2 <= 13, loop runs in fixed version (genuine witness)

nodes.description: When InflateRankDims returns *dims == NULL, dims is aliased to uncomp_buf+2, a 14-element window within the 16-element stack array. This alias is what makes an unchecked rank > 13 produce an out-of-bounds read.
nodes.evidence: dims_ptr == uncomp_buf_plus2_ptr in all observed traces

edges.description: matvar->rank is derived from nbytes / 4, where nbytes = uncomp_buf[1] is the attacker-controlled decompressed byte count. No bounds validation intervenes.
edges.evidence: nbytes_div4 == rank in all traces (694 == 694 for original, 2 == 2 for perturbation)
